examples.english: Several senators chose to abstain rather than vote for or against the controversial bill.
examples.persian: چند سناتور ترجیح دادند به‌جای رای موافق یا مخالف، رای ممتنع دهند و از رای‌گیری خودداری کنند.

examples.english: Doctors advised him to abstain from alcohol for at least six months after the surgery.
examples.persian: پزشکان به او توصیه کردند که حداقل شش ماه پس از جراحی از مصرف الکل خودداری کند.

examples.english: She decided to abstain from dessert until after the marathon.
examples.persian: او تصمیم گرفت تا پس از ماراتن از خوردن دسر خودداری کند.

miniContext: At the United Nations, a country that wishes to avoid taking a clear side on a resolution will often abstain rather than vote yes or no. Many religious traditions ask followers to abstain from certain foods during specific periods of fasting. Choosing to abstain is not the same as voting no; it is a deliberate refusal to take either position.

examples.english: The new irrigation system helped ameliorate the effects of the region's worsening drought.
examples.persian: سامانه آبیاری جدید به بهبود اثرات خشکسالی رو به تشدید این منطقه کمک کرد.

examples.english: City officials hoped the subsidy would ameliorate the housing crisis, at least temporarily.
examples.persian: مقامات شهری امید داشتند که این یارانه، حداقل به‌طور موقت، بحران مسکن را بهبود بخشد.

examples.english: Doctors prescribed physical therapy to ameliorate the chronic pain in her knee.
examples.persian: پزشکان فیزیوتراپی تجویز کردند تا درد مزمن زانوی او را بهبود بخشند.

miniContext: Economists have long argued over which policies actually ameliorate poverty rather than simply managing its symptoms. Minor reforms can ameliorate a broken system for a while, but they rarely fix the underlying causes of its failure. Aid organizations rushed in to ameliorate the aftermath of the earthquake, distributing food and clean water within days.

examples.english: Astronomers detected an anomalous signal coming from a region of space with no known stars.
examples.persian: ستاره‌شناسان سیگنالی غیرعادی را از ناحیه‌ای از فضا که هیچ ستاره شناخته‌شده‌ای در آن وجود ندارد، شناسایی کردند.

examples.english: The auditor flagged an anomalous transaction that didn't match any of the company's usual patterns.
examples.persian: حسابرس تراکنشی غیرعادی را علامت‌گذاری کرد که با هیچ‌کدام از الگوهای معمول شرکت مطابقت نداشت.

examples.english: Her blood test showed an anomalous spike in white cell count that doctors couldn't immediately explain.
examples.persian: آزمایش خون او افزایش غیرعادی در تعداد گلبول‌های سفید نشان داد که پزشکان نتوانستند فوراً آن را توضیح دهند.

miniContext: Weather stations recorded anomalous temperatures across the region that summer, far outside the normal seasonal range. Scientists are trained to treat anomalous results with suspicion, since a single strange reading is often a measurement error rather than a discovery. An anomalous pattern in trading data was eventually what led regulators to uncover the fraud.

examples.english: The customer grew belligerent when the airline refused to refund his ticket.
examples.persian: مشتری وقتی شرکت هواپیمایی از بازگرداندن پول بلیتش خودداری کرد، ستیزه‌جو شد.

examples.english: Historians describe the regime's belligerent foreign policy as a major cause of the war.
examples.persian: تاریخ‌نگاران سیاست خارجی ستیزه‌جویانه این حکومت را یکی از علل اصلی جنگ می‌دانند.

examples.english: He became belligerent after a few drinks, picking fights with strangers at the bar.
examples.persian: او پس از چند نوشیدنی ستیزه‌جو می‌شد و با غریبه‌ها در بار دعوا راه می‌انداخت.

miniContext: Diplomats grow wary of any neighboring state whose rhetoric turns suddenly belligerent after years of calm relations. A belligerent customer rarely gets better service than a calm one, no matter how justified the complaint. Military historians note that a belligerent stance in peacetime often signals a leader preparing the public for war.

examples.english: The lawyer advised her client to remain circumspect when speaking to reporters outside the courthouse.
examples.persian: وکیل به مشتری خود توصیه کرد هنگام صحبت با خبرنگاران بیرون دادگاه، محتاط و سنجیده رفتار کند.

examples.english: He was circumspect about sharing details of the merger before the deal was finalized.
examples.persian: او پیش از نهایی شدن قرارداد، درباره به اشتراک‌گذاشتن جزئیات ادغام محتاط بود.

examples.english: After the scandal, the company became far more circumspect in its public statements.
examples.persian: پس از این رسوایی، شرکت در بیانیه‌های عمومی خود بسیار محتاط‌تر شد.

miniContext: Seasoned negotiators remain circumspect about revealing their true priorities until the final stage of a deal. Being circumspect in a new job, observing office politics before speaking up, often prevents early, avoidable mistakes. The ambassador's circumspect wording left reporters unsure whether a formal agreement had actually been reached.

examples.english: Whether to save the failing factory or let it close presented the town with a genuine conundrum.
examples.persian: اینکه آیا باید کارخانه‌ی رو‌به‌تعطیلی را نجات داد یا اجازه داد تعطیل شود، معمای دشواری پیش روی شهر گذاشت.

examples.english: The detective faced a conundrum: both suspects had airtight alibis for the time of the murder.
examples.persian: کارآگاه با معمایی دشوار روبرو شد: هر دو مظنون برای زمان قتل بی‌گناهی قطعی داشتند.

examples.english: Balancing economic growth with environmental protection remains one of the great conundrums of modern policy.
examples.persian: توازن میان رشد اقتصادی و حفاظت از محیط‌زیست همچنان یکی از معماهای بزرگ سیاست‌گذاری مدرن است.

miniContext: Philosophers have debated the conundrum of free will for centuries without reaching a conclusion everyone accepts. A classic conundrum in economics asks why people pay more for brand-name products that are chemically identical to generic ones. The committee was left with an unsolvable conundrum once it became clear that satisfying one group of stakeholders meant alienating another.

examples.english: Two independent witnesses were able to corroborate the driver's account of the accident.
examples.persian: دو شاهد مستقل توانستند روایت راننده از تصادف را تایید کنند.

examples.english: New satellite images corroborate the researchers' theory about the ancient riverbed's original path.
examples.persian: تصاویر جدید ماهواره‌ای نظریه محققان درباره مسیر اصلی بستر رودخانه باستانی را تایید می‌کند.

examples.english: Prosecutors needed physical evidence to corroborate the informant's testimony before filing charges.
examples.persian: دادستان‌ها پیش از ثبت شکایت، به شواهد فیزیکی برای تایید شهادت خبرچین نیاز داشتند.

miniContext: Journalists are trained to corroborate a source's claim with at least one independent piece of evidence before publishing. Lab results that corroborate a diagnosis give doctors far more confidence than symptoms alone. Historians often struggle to corroborate accounts from ancient texts, since so few independent records from that era survive.

examples.english: Junior officers are expected to show deference to the admiral, even in informal settings.
examples.persian: از افسران جوان انتظار می‌رود حتی در موقعیت‌های غیررسمی نیز نسبت به دریادار احترام نشان دهند.

examples.english: She spoke with deference toward her mentor, careful never to interrupt.
examples.persian: او با احترام و ملاحظه با استادش صحبت می‌کرد و مراقب بود حرفش را قطع نکند.

examples.english: The court generally shows deference to the findings of the lower trial judge.
examples.persian: دادگاه عموماً نسبت به یافته‌های قاضی دادگاه بدوی احترام و ملاحظه نشان می‌دهد.

miniContext: Traditional societies often expect visible deference toward elders, shown through posture, tone, and the order in which people speak. In many legal systems, appellate courts owe deference to the factual findings made by the judge who actually heard the witnesses. Showing deference to a superior's opinion doesn't always mean agreeing with it, but it does mean choosing your words carefully.

examples.english: The treaty sought to delineate the exact border between the two mountain kingdoms.
examples.persian: این پیمان در پی مشخص کردن دقیق مرز میان دو پادشاهی کوهستانی بود.

examples.english: The contract fails to delineate who is responsible for cost overruns.
examples.persian: قرارداد مشخص نمی‌کند که مسئولیت افزایش هزینه‌ها بر عهده چه کسی است.

examples.english: Her opening statement clearly delineated the three main arguments she intended to make.
examples.persian: بیانیه ابتدایی او سه استدلال اصلی را که قصد داشت مطرح کند به‌دقت مشخص کرد.

miniContext: Surveyors used old maps and stone markers to delineate the property boundary that two feuding neighbors had disputed for years. Good contracts delineate every party's responsibilities precisely, leaving no room for later disagreement. A biologist's first task when studying a new species is often to delineate the edges of its habitat.

examples.english: The referee's egregious error in the final minute cost the team the championship.
examples.persian: اشتباه بسیار بد و آشکار داور در دقیقه پایانی، قهرمانی را از این تیم گرفت.

examples.english: Auditors uncovered an egregious case of fraud spanning nearly a decade.
examples.persian: حسابرسان موردی بسیار بد از کلاهبرداری را کشف کردند که نزدیک به یک دهه ادامه داشت.

examples.english: His egregious disregard for safety protocols eventually led to his dismissal.
examples.persian: بی‌توجهی آشکار و شدید او به پروتکل‌های ایمنی سرانجام به اخراجش منجر شد.

miniContext: Editors reserve the word egregious for mistakes so glaring that readers wonder how they slipped past review at all. An egregious violation of trust, like embezzling from a charity, tends to draw far harsher punishment than an ordinary crime of the same financial scale. The judge called the company's conduct egregious, citing years of ignored warnings before the factory finally collapsed.

examples.english: The spokesperson gave an equivocal answer that satisfied neither side of the debate.
examples.persian: سخنگو پاسخی دوپهلو و مبهم داد که هیچ‌کدام از دو طرف بحث را راضی نکرد.

examples.english: Scientists called the results equivocal, since the data could support two opposite conclusions.
examples.persian: دانشمندان نتایج را مبهم و دوپهلو خواندند، چون داده‌ها می‌توانستند از دو نتیجه متضاد حمایت کنند.

examples.english: His equivocal response left the board unsure whether he intended to resign.
examples.persian: پاسخ دوپهلوی او هیئت مدیره را در این باره که آیا قصد استعفا دارد یا نه، بلاتکلیف گذاشت.

miniContext: Oracles in ancient myth were famous for equivocal prophecies that could be read two completely different ways depending on the outcome. A politician's equivocal statement on a divisive issue often reflects a calculated effort to avoid alienating either side of the electorate. Clinical trial results that remain equivocal usually require a larger, better-designed study before any firm conclusion can be drawn.

examples.english: The editor was fastidious about grammar, flagging even the smallest misplaced comma.
examples.persian: ویراستار نسبت به دستور زبان بسیار سخت‌گیر و دقیق بود و حتی کوچک‌ترین ویرگول نادرست را علامت‌گذاری می‌کرد.

examples.english: He kept a fastidious record of every expense down to the last cent.
examples.persian: او سوابق بسیار دقیقی از هر هزینه، حتی تا آخرین سنت، نگه می‌داشت.

examples.english: She is fastidious about her kitchen, scrubbing every surface after each meal.
examples.persian: او نسبت به آشپزخانه‌اش بسیار سخت‌گیر است و پس از هر وعده غذا تمام سطوح را تمیز می‌کند.

miniContext: Museum conservators must be fastidious, documenting every crack and discoloration before attempting any repair. Being fastidious about small details can be a professional asset in fields like accounting or surgery, where a single overlooked error carries real consequences. His fastidious attention to his appearance bordered on obsession, taking nearly an hour to prepare for any outing.

examples.english: A fortuitous meeting at a conference led to the partnership that eventually built the company.
examples.persian: یک ملاقات تصادفی و خوشایند در یک کنفرانس، به شراکتی منجر شد که سرانجام این شرکت را بنا کرد.

examples.english: Finding a parking spot right outside the venue felt almost fortuitous given the crowd.
examples.persian: پیدا کردن جای پارک درست روبه‌روی محل برگزاری، با توجه به ازدحام جمعیت، تقریباً شانسی بود.

examples.english: The fortuitous timing of the rain saved the crops just before the drought would have ruined them.
examples.persian: زمان‌بندی تصادفی و خوشایند بارش باران، محصولات را دقیقاً پیش از آنکه خشکسالی آن‌ها را نابود کند نجات داد.

miniContext: Scientific history is full of fortuitous accidents, from Fleming's contaminated petri dish to the discovery of the microwave oven. A fortuitous delay kept her off the flight that was later grounded for mechanical trouble. Not every fortuitous break is luck alone; some people simply put themselves in more positions where lucky things can happen.

meaning: بیش از حد باشکوه و بلندپروازانه

examples.english: The mayor unveiled a grandiose plan to build the tallest tower on the continent.
examples.persian: شهردار طرحی بیش از حد باشکوه و بلندپروازانه برای ساخت بلندترین برج قاره رونمایی کرد.

examples.english: Critics mocked the film's grandiose dialogue, which sounded absurd in such a small story.
examples.persian: منتقدان دیالوگ‌های بیش از حد باشکوه فیلم را که در داستانی کوچک پوچ به نظر می‌رسید، به باد انتقاد گرفتند.

examples.english: His grandiose promises during the campaign were quietly forgotten within a year of taking office.
examples.persian: وعده‌های بلندپروازانه او در طول کمپین، ظرف یک سال پس از به قدرت رسیدن، بی‌صدا فراموش شدند.

miniContext: Dictators throughout history have favored grandiose architecture, building monuments meant to outlast their own fragile regimes. A grandiose vision can inspire a team for a while, but it eventually needs a realistic plan behind it. His grandiose claim that the invention would end world hunger drew more skepticism than investment.

examples.english: The leak was inadvertent; an employee had simply forgotten to lock the shared folder.
examples.persian: این افشای اطلاعات سهوی بود؛ یک کارمند صرفاً فراموش کرده بود پوشه مشترک را قفل کند.

examples.english: Her inadvertent comment about the surprise party nearly ruined the whole plan.
examples.persian: نظر ناخواسته او درباره جشن غافلگیرکننده تقریباً کل برنامه را خراب کرد.

examples.english: The software bug caused an inadvertent deletion of three months of customer records.
examples.persian: باگ نرم‌افزاری باعث حذف ناخواسته سه ماه از سوابق مشتریان شد.

miniContext: Editors distinguish between a deliberate lie and an inadvertent error, though readers rarely extend the same patience. An inadvertent slip of the tongue during a live broadcast can follow a public figure for years. The regulation was meant to close a loophole, but it had the inadvertent effect of punishing small businesses far more than large ones.

examples.english: The indefatigable volunteers worked through the night, sorting donations for the flood victims.
examples.persian: داوطلبان خستگی‌ناپذیر تمام شب کار کردند تا کمک‌های اهدایی را برای قربانیان سیل دسته‌بندی کنند.

examples.english: She was indefatigable on the campaign trail, giving five speeches in a single day.
examples.persian: او در مسیر مبارزات انتخاباتی خستگی‌ناپذیر بود و در یک روز پنج سخنرانی ایراد کرد.

examples.english: His indefatigable curiosity kept him running experiments well into his eighties.
examples.persian: کنجکاوی خستگی‌ناپذیر او باعث شد تا اواخر دهه هشتاد زندگی‌اش همچنان به آزمایش کردن ادامه دهد.

miniContext: Marathon runners admire the indefatigable pace of elite athletes who seem to never slow down even in the final miles. An indefatigable researcher can spend decades on a single unsolved problem without losing enthusiasm. Nurses on the night shift are often praised as indefatigable, somehow staying sharp through exhaustion that would stop most people cold.

examples.english: The union remained intransigent, rejecting every offer the company proposed over three months of talks.
examples.persian: اتحادیه همچنان سازش‌ناپذیر ماند و در طول سه ماه مذاکره، هر پیشنهادی را که شرکت ارائه داد رد کرد.

examples.english: Her intransigent stance on the issue cost her several potential allies in parliament.
examples.persian: موضع سازش‌ناپذیر او در این مسئله، چند متحد بالقوه را در پارلمان از او گرفت.

examples.english: Negotiations stalled because both sides proved equally intransigent on the question of borders.
examples.persian: مذاکرات به بن‌بست رسید چون هر دو طرف در مسئله مرزها به یک اندازه سازش‌ناپذیر بودند.

miniContext: Mediators often struggle most not with the issues themselves but with parties who remain intransigent out of pride rather than principle. An intransigent board member can block a merger single-handedly if the bylaws require unanimous consent. Historians note that the war dragged on partly because both governments were too intransigent to accept anything short of total victory.

examples.english: The old farmer gave a laconic nod and returned to his work without another word.
examples.persian: کشاورز پیر با سری کم‌حرف و کوتاه سر تکان داد و بدون حرف دیگری به کارش برگشت.

examples.english: Her laconic texts, usually just a word or two, frustrated friends who wanted real conversation.
examples.persian: پیام‌های کوتاه و کم‌حرف او، که معمولاً فقط یک یا دو کلمه بود، دوستانی را که گفتگوی واقعی می‌خواستند ناامید می‌کرد.

examples.english: Spartans were famous for their laconic replies, often answering entire speeches with a single word.
examples.persian: اسپارتی‌ها به پاسخ‌های کوتاه و مختصرشان مشهور بودند و اغلب به کل یک سخنرانی تنها با یک کلمه پاسخ می‌دادند.

miniContext: Detective novels often give the hardened investigator a laconic style of speech, as if every word costs him something. Being laconic in an email can come across as cold, even when the sender only meant to be brief. The general's laconic order, just two words long, was relayed down the chain of command within minutes.

examples.english: The winning team's captain was magnanimous in victory, praising the losing side's effort.
examples.persian: کاپیتان تیم برنده در پیروزی بزرگوارانه رفتار کرد و از تلاش تیم بازنده تقدیر کرد.

examples.english: In a magnanimous gesture, the landlord waived the final month's rent for the struggling tenant.
examples.persian: صاحبخانه با حرکتی بزرگوارانه، اجاره آخرین ماه را برای مستأجر در تنگنا بخشید.

examples.english: He remained magnanimous toward the colleague who had tried to take credit for his work.
examples.persian: او نسبت به همکاری که سعی کرده بود اعتبار کار او را بدزدد، همچنان بزرگوارانه رفتار کرد.

miniContext: Nelson Mandela's magnanimous treatment of his former jailers after decades in prison surprised even his closest allies. Being magnanimous after a hard-won argument, rather than gloating, tends to preserve a friendship far better than victory alone. The company's magnanimous severance package softened the blow for employees laid off during the restructuring.

examples.english: The chef's mercurial temper was well known in the kitchen, swinging from praise to fury within minutes.
examples.persian: خوی دمدمی‌مزاج سرآشپز در آشپزخانه معروف بود و ظرف چند دقیقه از تحسین به خشم تغییر می‌کرد.

examples.english: Investors grew wary of the mercurial founder, whose strategy seemed to change every quarter.
examples.persian: سرمایه‌گذاران نسبت به بنیانگذار دمدمی‌مزاج که استراتژی‌اش هر فصل تغییر می‌کرد، محتاط شدند.

examples.english: Spring weather in the mountains is mercurial, shifting from sunshine to snow within an hour.
examples.persian: آب‌وهوای بهاری در کوهستان متغیر و دمدمی است و ظرف یک ساعت از آفتاب به برف تبدیل می‌شود.

miniContext: Shakespeare's tragic heroes are often mercurial, shifting from calm reflection to violent rage within a single scene. A mercurial boss keeps a team constantly on edge, never certain which mood will greet them each morning. The stock of a mercurial industry like fashion can swing wildly based on a single celebrity endorsement.

examples.english: Engineers built retaining walls to mitigate the risk of landslides during heavy rain.
examples.persian: مهندسان دیوارهای حائل ساختند تا خطر رانش زمین در زمان بارش شدید را کاهش دهند.

examples.english: The company offered compensation to mitigate the damage caused by the data breach.
examples.persian: شرکت غرامتی ارائه داد تا خسارت ناشی از نشت اطلاعات را کاهش دهد.

examples.english: Regular stretching can mitigate the soreness that follows an intense workout.
examples.persian: کشش منظم عضلات می‌تواند درد پس از تمرین شدید را کاهش دهد.

miniContext: Governments invest heavily in seawalls and early warning systems to mitigate the damage from future storms. No treatment can fully cure the condition, but several drugs can mitigate its most painful symptoms. Diplomats worked around the clock to mitigate the fallout from the leaked documents before relations between the two countries collapsed entirely.

examples.english: The company's lawyers used dense legal language to obfuscate the contract's actual terms.
examples.persian: وکلای شرکت از زبان حقوقی پیچیده استفاده کردند تا شرایط واقعی قرارداد را مبهم کنند.

examples.english: Bureaucratic jargon can obfuscate even the simplest policy change.
examples.persian: زبان بیوروکراتیک حتی می‌تواند ساده‌ترین تغییر سیاستی را مبهم کند.

examples.english: He used technical language to obfuscate how little progress had actually been made.
examples.persian: او از زبان فنی استفاده کرد تا مبهم کند که در واقع چه میزان کم پیشرفت حاصل شده است.

miniContext: Propaganda often works not by lying outright but by using vague language to obfuscate uncomfortable facts. Corporate reports sometimes obfuscate declining profits behind dense charts and unfamiliar accounting terms. A good teacher clarifies a difficult concept; a bad one tends to obfuscate it further with unnecessary jargon.

examples.english: The ostensible reason for the trip was business, though everyone suspected a vacation in disguise.
examples.persian: دلیل ظاهری این سفر کاری بود، هرچند همه گمان می‌کردند در واقع تعطیلاتی پنهان‌شده است.

examples.english: Her ostensible support for the project hid serious doubts she shared only with close friends.
examples.persian: پشتیبانی ظاهری او از این پروژه، تردیدهای جدی‌اش را که تنها با دوستان نزدیک در میان گذاشته بود، پنهان می‌کرد.

examples.english: The meeting's ostensible purpose was budget review, but layoffs were the real agenda.
examples.persian: هدف ظاهری این جلسه بازبینی بودجه بود، اما موضوع اصلی اخراج نیروها بود.

miniContext: Historians often distinguish between a war's ostensible cause, the event reported in the news, and its deeper economic roots. The charity's ostensible mission was disaster relief, though most of its budget went toward administrative salaries. His ostensible calm during the crisis hid a panic he confided to no one until much later.

examples.english: The inspector gave the building a perfunctory glance before signing off on its safety.
examples.persian: بازرس نگاهی سطحی و بدون دقت به ساختمان انداخت و پیش از تایید ایمنی آن را امضا کرد.

examples.english: His perfunctory apology, delivered without eye contact, satisfied no one in the room.
examples.persian: عذرخواهی سطحی او که بدون نگاه کردن به چشم‌ها انجام شد، هیچ‌کس در اتاق را راضی نکرد.

examples.english: The committee's perfunctory review missed several errors that a careful reading would have caught.
examples.persian: بازبینی سطحی کمیته چندین اشتباه را که یک بررسی دقیق متوجه آن می‌شد، از قلم انداخت.

miniContext: Students who give a perfunctory answer on an essay question rarely fool a teacher looking for genuine understanding. A perfunctory handshake, offered without eye contact, can set an oddly cold tone for an entire meeting. The factory's perfunctory safety checks, carried out in minutes rather than hours, were later blamed for the accident.

examples.english: With its red phone booths and double-decker buses, the street scene was quintessential London.
examples.persian: با آن باجه‌های تلفن قرمز و اتوبوس‌های دوطبقه، آن صحنه خیابانی نمونه کامل لندن بود.

examples.english: Critics called the film a quintessential example of 1970s American cinema.
examples.persian: منتقدان این فیلم را نمونه برجسته و کامل سینمای آمریکایی دهه ۱۹۷۰ خطاب کردند.

examples.english: A quiet cottage by the sea is the quintessential image of a peaceful retirement.
examples.persian: یک کلبه آرام در کنار دریا، تصویر نمونه کامل یک بازنشستگی آرام است.

miniContext: Sherlock Holmes remains the quintessential fictional detective, the figure every later mystery writer measures their own sleuth against. A quintessential example of Renaissance art, the fresco combines religious subject matter with unmistakably human emotion. Food critics describe the dish as quintessential comfort food, simple ingredients transformed by careful technique.

examples.english: The recalcitrant mule refused to move no matter how hard the farmer pulled.
examples.persian: قاطر سرکش هرچقدر کشاورز می‌کشید، حاضر به حرکت نبود.

examples.english: Teachers struggled to reach the recalcitrant student who refused to complete any assignment.
examples.persian: معلمان برای برقراری ارتباط با دانش‌آموز سرکشی که از انجام هیچ تکلیفی خودداری می‌کرد، تلاش می‌کردند.

examples.english: The recalcitrant stain remained on the carpet despite three different cleaning attempts.
examples.persian: لکه سرسخت و مقاوم با وجود سه بار تلاش مختلف برای تمیز کردن، روی فرش باقی ماند.

miniContext: Prison reform programs often struggle with the most recalcitrant offenders, those who resist every attempt at rehabilitation. A recalcitrant committee member can delay a vote for months simply by refusing to compromise on minor wording. Farmers have long complained about recalcitrant weeds that survive even the strongest herbicides.

examples.english: The sagacious old judge was known for seeing through lies that fooled everyone else in the courtroom.
examples.persian: قاضی پیر و خردمند به خاطر دیدن دروغ‌هایی که همه دیگران در دادگاه فریب می‌خوردند، شناخته می‌شد.

examples.english: Her sagacious advice about the merger proved correct within a year, when the deal collapsed exactly as she predicted.
examples.persian: توصیه خردمندانه و دوراندیش او درباره ادغام، ظرف یک سال درست از آب درآمد، وقتی قرارداد دقیقاً همان‌طور که او پیش‌بینی کرده بود فروپاشید.

examples.english: Villagers sought out the sagacious elder whenever a dispute needed settling.
examples.persian: روستاییان هر زمان که نیاز به حل‌وفصل یک اختلاف بود، به سراغ پیر خردمند روستا می‌رفتند.

miniContext: Owls have long symbolized wisdom in Western folklore, though the sagacious reputation has little to do with the birds' actual intelligence. A sagacious investor resists the temptation to follow every market trend, focusing instead on fundamentals that rarely change. The sagacious counsel of her grandmother, who had survived two wars, shaped how she approached every crisis afterward.

examples.english: The tenacious reporter spent three years chasing the story that eventually exposed the scandal.
examples.persian: خبرنگار سمج و پیگیر سه سال را صرف دنبال کردن داستانی کرد که سرانجام این رسوایی را فاش کرد.

examples.english: Ivy is a tenacious plant, capable of climbing a wall even after repeated attempts to remove it.
examples.persian: پیچک گیاهی سمج است که حتی پس از چند بار تلاش برای حذف آن، همچنان می‌تواند از دیوار بالا برود.

examples.english: Her tenacious defense of the case impressed even the opposing counsel.
examples.persian: دفاع سمجانه و پیگیر او از این پرونده، حتی وکیل طرف مقابل را تحت تاثیر قرار داد.

miniContext: Marathon training rewards a tenacious mindset more than raw talent, since most runners eventually hit a wall that only persistence gets them past. The tenacious root system of this grass species allows it to survive droughts that kill nearly everything else nearby. Being tenacious in the face of repeated rejection is, by most accounts, what separates published novelists from unpublished ones.

examples.english: Smartphones have become so ubiquitous that entire industries now assume every customer owns one.
examples.persian: گوشی‌های هوشمند آن‌قدر همه‌جا حاضر شده‌اند که صنایع کامل اکنون فرض می‌کنند هر مشتری یکی از آن‌ها را دارد.

examples.english: Plastic packaging is ubiquitous in modern supermarkets, wrapped around even single pieces of fruit.
examples.persian: بسته‌بندی پلاستیکی در سوپرمارکت‌های مدرن همه‌جا حاضر است و حتی تک‌تک میوه‌ها را نیز می‌پوشاند.

examples.english: The company's logo is ubiquitous across the city, appearing on buses, billboards, and storefronts alike.
examples.persian: لوگوی این شرکت در سطح شهر همه‌جا حاضر است و روی اتوبوس‌ها، بیلبوردها و ویترین مغازه‌ها دیده می‌شود.

miniContext: Coffee shops have become so ubiquitous in major cities that finding one within walking distance is rarely a challenge. Microplastics are now considered ubiquitous in the ocean, found in samples from the deepest trenches to the surface. Surveillance cameras are increasingly ubiquitous in public spaces, raising new questions about privacy that previous generations never had to consider.

examples.english: A vociferous group of protesters gathered outside city hall, chanting for hours.
examples.persian: گروهی از معترضان پرسروصدا بیرون شهرداری جمع شدند و ساعت‌ها شعار دادند.

examples.english: She has long been a vociferous critic of the industry's environmental record.
examples.persian: او مدت‌هاست منتقدی پرسروصدا و شدید نسبت به سابقه زیست‌محیطی این صنعت بوده است.

examples.english: The vociferous crowd booed every decision the referee made in the second half.
examples.persian: جمعیت پرسروصدا هر تصمیم داور را در نیمه دوم با سوت و هو مواجه کرد.

miniContext: Town hall meetings often attract a small but vociferous minority whose objections can drown out the quieter majority. A vociferous shareholder revolt eventually forced the board to reconsider the merger entirely. Being vociferous about an issue doesn't guarantee being right, but it almost always guarantees being heard.
